most_similar_reason: Candidate 10 is essentially the same work: an advisor instructs a ruler through a nested cycle of animal fables that includes the scheming jackal-type courtier at a lion king's court who destroys a friendship, the four weak friends (crow, mouse, turtle, deer) who save each other, and the war between crows and owls won by infiltration.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 6 describes an agricultural harvest custom of making a straw figure to house a grain spirit, with no instructive frame narrative, no animal fables, and no characters at all.
